name: Ivory Coast
description: Ivory Coast from its kingdoms to French rule, Houphouët-Boigny, civil wars, cocoa and today.

checkpoints.name: Kingdoms
checkpoints.note: Kong, the Baoulé and other peoples ruled the land.

checkpoints.name: French colony
checkpoints.note: France made the coast a colony in 1893.

checkpoints.name: Ivory Coast
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1960. Cocoa brought wealth, and civil wars came in 2002 and 2010.
